data.one_liner: Sanitizes strings by removing or replacing characters illegal for filenames.
data.what_it_does: The package replaces characters that are unsafe or illegal in filenames with a safe alternative. You can specify a custom replacement character. It works on all supported Dart platforms.
use_when: You need to store user‑provided text as a file name
Cross‑platform filename safety without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require full path validation or complex sanitization rules
You need asynchronous or stream‑based processing
weaknesses: Only handles character replacement, no path normalization
